title: rubus sativus
intro: Rubus sativus, commonly known as sea buckthorn, is a thorny shrub native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia. It is a rich source of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants that provide numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-boosting properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus sativus include wound healing, skin regeneration, and protection against cardiovascular disease due to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, carotenoids, and fatty acids. The bioactive constituents of Rubus sativus, including flavonoids like quercetin and kaempferol, contribute to its therapeutic effects and health benefits.
